_meta.verification_method: WebFetch of the live official pricing page during this milestone (not reused from any prior cached/dated table)
_meta.note: The 2026-08-06 milestone's own pricing note (Claude Sonnet 5 introductory $2/$10 through 2026-08-31, reverting to $3/$15 on 2026-09-01) is SUPERSEDED. The live page fetched on 2026-08-14 states the scheduled increase 'will not occur' and $2/$10 is now the permanent standard price for claude-sonnet-5. All amounts are USD per million tokens (MTok), as decimal strings for exact Decimal parsing -- never float. cache_write_5m/cache_write_1h/cache_read are absolute per-MTok rates (already multiplied out from the base-input-price multipliers the pricing page states: 1.25x/2x/0.1x), not multipliers themselves, so callers never need to re-derive them.
_meta.unpriced_model_policy: A model string not present as a key below is unpriced -- callers must report cost as unavailable (priced: false) rather than guessing a nearby model's rate or defaulting to any entry here.
_meta.aliases_note: 'aliases' maps a dated model id the runtime records in transcripts/modelUsage to the pricing key of the same model. Each entry is taken from the runtime's own canonicalModel field for that id (observed 2026-09-29 in a headless result: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001' -> canonicalModel 'claude-haiku-4-5'). Only exact alias hits are used; no prefix or fuzzy matching.
